name: Expansion permit
description: Build one outer city beyond the research limit.

name: Breakthrough stone
description: Raise one building's level cap by 1-3 (random).

name: Land grant
description: One more building slot in an outer city.

name: Granary voucher
description: Draw grain from the ever-normal granary: food for a settlement.

name: Imperial timber voucher
description: Timber purchased for the court: wood for a settlement.

name: Quarry voucher
description: Stone cut from the hills for building: stone for a settlement.

name: Iron tax voucher
description: The year's iron tax from the mines: metal for a settlement.

name: Thousand-string note
description: A note worth a thousand strings of cash: currency for a settlement.

name: Works memo
description: The Ministry of Works urges haste: the construction finishing soonest here, 15 minutes sooner.

name: Works order
description: The Ministry of Works urges haste: the construction finishing soonest here, 1 hour sooner.

name: Directorate of Works decree
description: The Ministry of Works urges haste: the construction finishing soonest here, 8 hours sooner.

name: Drill memo
description: A summons from the Bureau of Military Affairs: the training here, 15 minutes sooner.

name: Drill order
description: A summons from the Bureau of Military Affairs: the training here, 1 hour sooner.

name: Military Affairs decree
description: A summons from the Bureau of Military Affairs: the training here, 8 hours sooner.

name: Collation memo
description: Hanlin scholars collate through the night: the research here, 15 minutes sooner.

name: Collation order
description: Hanlin scholars collate through the night: the research here, 1 hour sooner.

name: Hanlin Academy decree
description: Hanlin scholars collate through the night: the research here, 8 hours sooner.

name: Harvest prayer
description: Offerings to the gods of soil and grain: all production of a settlement +25% for 24 hours (another one adds 24 hours).

name: Golden wound salve
description: The finest salve for wounds: an injured hero is healed at once.

name: Scrap of a war manual
description: Torn pages, yet the essence of the art of war shows through: a hero gains 1,000 experience.

name: Complete Essentials of the Military Classics
description: Compiled by imperial order, the sum of military learning: a hero gains 10,000 experience.

name: Marrow-cleansing pill
description: Cleanse the marrow, be reborn: every free point a hero has spent comes back to spend again.

name: Scrap metal
description: Broken pots and rusty blades: melt them down for 300 metal in a settlement.
